items.hit: Open one issue and PR per release range, read the migration guide for that range, push fixes until COGGS Auto passes.
items.auto: depth-first-qa proves the game still renders and plays the same.

source.note: Engine major migration: Auto proves it is the same game, Hit owns the change.

items.item: Dependency, SDK and engine version bump PRs
items.hit: Bump pinned engine and CDN revisions and open the PR.

source.note: Dependency, SDK and engine bump PRs: Hit owns, Auto proves.

items.hit: Read the guide and both versions of the source, commit the fix, rerun Auto.
items.auto: Gives a hypothesis hint only; never names a fix.

source.note: Cause finding and fix commits are Hit; Auto gives hints marked hypothesis.

items.item: Hand over after three failed fixes
items.hit: Label the PR needs-human after three fixes fail.

source.note: Three failed fixes hand the PR to a person.

items.hit: Cite the published advisory in the issue, rebuild and redeploy every shipped build (Unity CVE-2025-59489 asked for exactly this).
items.auto: Proves the rebuilt game is the same.

source.note: Engine security vulnerability: rebuild and redeploy already shipped games.

items.item: Latest recommended Android and iOS SDK
items.hit: Raise target API (35, then 36) and the Xcode version each store requires, fix build failures, permissions and edge-to-edge.
items.auto: Plays the rebuilt app on devices.

source.note: Follow the latest recommended Android/iOS SDK: target API 36 and 35, Xcode 26.

items.hit: Rebuild native libraries aligned for 16 KB pages before publishing is blocked.
items.auto: Plays the rebuilt app on a 16 KB device image.

source.note: Android requires 16 KB page support; Unity forum shows publishing blocked by it in 2025.

items.hit: Move to Play Billing Library 8 by 2026-08-31 and to each later required version.
items.auto: Replays the purchase flow on a test track.

source.note: Play requires Billing Library 8 by 2026-08-31.

items.hit: Upgrade or replace each SDK that breaks the build when the target API rises.

source.note: Every yearly forum snapshot 2023 to 2026 shows third-party SDKs breaking target API raises.

items.hit: Keep the app and every third-party SDK privacy manifest current.

source.note: Apple requires a privacy manifest for the app and each third-party SDK.

items.hit: Answer each store age-rating questionnaire when it changes (Apple asked by 2026-01-31).

source.note: Apple required new age-rating answers by 2026-01-31; 2026 delistings over ratings appear.

items.hit: Watch crash and ANR rates against the store thresholds and answer regressions.
items.auto: Reproduces a reported crash from its inputs.

source.note: Play ties crash and ANR thresholds to store visibility.

items.hit: Schedule the store pre-launch crawl and device-farm runs and read them before release.

source.note: Play runs a pre-launch crawl on its device lab for every uploaded build.

items.hit: Keep declared hardware true to what the build runs on.

source.note: Apple and Play reject builds that do not run on the hardware they claim.

items.item: Store submission, rejection and resubmission, metadata
items.hit: Submit, read the rejection, fix and resubmit; keep metadata accurate.

source.note: Store submission, resubmission, metadata, age rating and privacy manifest are Hit.

items.item: Closed test with 12 testers for 14 days
items.hit: Run the closed test before production on a personal developer account; an organization account is outside the rule.

source.note: Personal accounts made after 2023-11-13 need 12 opted-in testers for 14 days before production.

items.hit: Keep developer identity and contact current; a person reads the account mail and enters the one-time code.

source.note: Unverified contact details restrict the account and its apps.

items.hit: Test every platform a build shipped to on every update.

source.note: The standard asks for testing on every platform the game shipped to.

items.hit: Keep login, download and network paths available, fault tolerant and recoverable.

source.note: ISO 25010 reliability: availability, fault tolerance, recovery.

items.hit: Keep behaviour analytics wired through each upgrade.

source.note: The survey treats behaviour analytics as a test layer.
